paragraphs: In [Temurah 21a](https://www.sefaria.org/Temurah.21a.6-7) he says: “They asked in the West…” – Abaye said to him, etc.[^1]

notes.text: Rava bar Rav Azza reports the question from the West. Abaye then addresses him directly. The linked text has בען where Hyman supplies בעו.
